_comment_scope: Read only by the template-authoring desktop (hdw4s template edit), bound over hdw4s-author.json in the managed policy directory. Merged with hdw4s-ephemeral.json, which sets none of these keys.

_comment_history: Not created, so not harvested: the cheapest filter is the trace that never existed.
